audit_items.proof_trace: BlobRPCMinValidSlot only checks DenebForkEpoch, never FuluForkEpoch. After FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS, blob_sidecars_by_range should return empty (as blobs are replaced by data columns), but the function continues to calculate minStartSlot based on currEpoch - minReqEpochs without any upper bound check against Fulu activation.
audit_items.attack_scenario: After Fulu activates and MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS passes, peers can still request blob sidecars via blob_sidecars_by_range RPC. The handler will serve stale blob data instead of rejecting the request or returning empty, violating the protocol's data availability transition from blobs to data columns.
